name: research
description: Materialize reproducible experiments across verified GPU rigs: scaffold projects, provision exact environments, deploy tested revisions, dispatch GPU waves as a self-balancing pull queue, supervise them from the hub without an open chat, keep a fleet-wide GPU lane board, and visualize results.

interface.shortDescription: Reproducible GPU experiments across verified rigs
interface.longDescription: Scaffold fresh Research 2.0 projects under an explicit engineering execution agreement, provision exact uv environments, deploy tested revisions, dispatch GPU waves as a pull queue over rig lanes and Slurm jobs, supervise them with a hub service and an unattended agent (rebalancing, fault recovery, offload of disk-constrained rigs, per-GPU status table), keep a fleet-wide board of which rig GPUs every project holds, reconcile run state, maintain a narrative journal, and create approved result visualizations.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a fresh Research 2.0 project with engineering, environment, and rig contracts.
Provision the exact uv environment and verify parity across my rigs.
Compile an approved research step into a reproducible experiment and monitor its GPU wave through completion.
Plot my evaluation results as approved self-contained interactive HTML.
Which GPUs are free across my projects right now, and who holds the rest until when?
